description:
Find official statistical indicators by natural language, in English or Spanish. Use this first when you do not know the exact indicator id.
Coverage: the United States (nation, states, counties, and population for cities of 10,000 or more), EU countries and regions, Spain (municipalities, provinces, regions, national), the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Ireland and New Zealand (national and regional series from their statistics offices), and every country plus the World from the World Bank. Topics: population and demography, unemployment and employment, prices and inflation, income and poverty, GDP, housing, companies, tourism, interest rates, public finance, health, AI and digital economy, energy, emissions, agriculture.
Pass geography when the question is about a specific place: only indicators with data for that place are listed, and matches published elsewhere are named in not_available_for_place.
Example: {"query": "tasa de paro", "geography": "Mataró"}.
Returns {indicators: [{id, name, unit, frequencies, levels, definition, note?}], place?, not_available_for_place?}. Read note: it explains common confusions, such as survey unemployment rate versus registered unemployment.

geography.description: Optional place the data is for. Same format as place in the other tools.

query.description: What you are looking for, for example "inflation", "paro registrado", "average income per person".
